schema:
CREATE TABLE departments (dept_id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, building TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE employees (emp_id INT PRIMARY KEY, dept_id INT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, salary INT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments(dept_id));
correct_query: SELECT name FROM departments WHERE dept_id IN (SELECT dept_id FROM employees WHERE salary > 50000);
